name: cyberhuatuo
description: CyberHuaTuo Claude Code plugin marketplace: when an agent gets sick, let it ask HuaTuo, fix the error, and keep the cure.

plugins.name: cyberhuatuo-plugin
plugins.description: When a coding agent gets sick, CyberHuaTuo checks the traceback for an offline Gold cure through MCP, returns at most one clearly labeled Reviewed candidate when Gold does not match, lets agents apply the cure only with appropriate approval, then falls back to broader diagnosis. Agents can save or upload solved cases as a reusable draft prescription; accepted prescriptions unlock the First Soul Ring path. A bundled PreToolUse guard also reviews destructive shell actions before execution.
